name: TachiyomiAZ iOS
subtitle: Tachiyomi extension compatibility for iPhone and iPad
description: A sideload-focused manga reader for iOS and iPadOS with user-provided Tachiyomi and TachiyomiX extension repositories.

apps.name: TachiyomiAZ
apps.subtitle: A Tachiyomi-compatible manga reader for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Browse and read manga using repositories and extensions supplied by the user. Includes library management, downloads, tracking, source filters, and Mihon-compatible backups.

privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: TachiyomiAZ uses Face ID for user-configured library locking.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: TachiyomiAZ needs permission to save pages to your photo library.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: TachiyomiAZ needs permission to connect to local Komga and Kavita servers.
